answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 10% intake cap on the established set per close. Remember that the river does not care what the account calls itself. The distinction matters: a quartz you can audit is a quartz a farm has to pay for. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: a 5-seat intake floor keeps the draw pool from freezing shut. Which is only to say that the horizon outlives the account that produced it.
